means: Super-deformed proportions - a two-to-three-head-tall figure with an oversized head, tiny limbs and simplified features. Japanese comedy shorthand.
does: Danbooru grammar with real force: it does not decorate a character, it REPLACES the character design. Everything you wrote about build, height, posture and costume detail is overridden, because chibi carries its own body plan. studio/cards/anime_fx_deform_mode.json makes exactly this point - chibi swaps the character for a comedy design rather than applying an effect to them, which is why it lives in its own variable - and the emote_symbols card review flags chibi_pop as wrongly filed for the same reason, noting it will redraw the whole character while every other option on that card is a small addition.
reach_for_it: comedy beats where the stakes are being deliberately reset. Decide the SCOPE first - a chibi inset in the corner of a serious frame and a whole chibi shot are different jokes with different timing.
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
